# dart_monty — index for LLM/agent consumers

Higher-level Dart wrapper around `dart_monty_core` (the Rust-backed
sandboxed Python interpreter). Adds a Bridge, Extensions, host
functions, and a runtime that orchestrates them. If you're driving
this package from an LLM agent, start with these files in order:

## Quick start

- `README.md` — overview, install path (GitHub-only, NOT pub.dev),
  three-tier smoke test, security model
- `docs/index.md` — same surface as the README in mkdocs form
- `docs/user/install.md` — full install + verifying-the-install
  recipe
- `docs/user/api-reference.md` — `Monty`, `MontyRuntime`,
  `Monty.typeCheck`, `MontyResult`

## Subset rules (read first to avoid runtime surprises)

- README's "Monty is a Python *subset*" section enumerates what's
  allowed, what isn't, and what `typeCheck` catches before runtime.
- `docs/architecture/overview.md` — module structure, supported
  platforms, FFI vs WASM dispatch.

## Going further

- `docs/user/repl.md` — stateful interactive execution
- `docs/user/extensions.md` — Template, MessageBus, Sandbox extensions
- `docs/deep-dives/oscall-vfs.md` — VFS + filesystem sandbox boundary
- `docs/deep-dives/sandbox-architecture.md` — parent ↔ child runtime
  topology
- `docs/contributor/setup.md` — build and test the package

## Examples

- `example/example.dart` — minimal `Monty.exec` one-shots
- `example/type_check_demo.dart` — pre-flight type checking
- `example/dataclass_demo.dart` — stateful round-trip with
  `MontyRuntime.execute`

## What's NOT on the doc surface

`lib/src/**`, `test/**`, `tool/**`, `hook/**`, and `native/**` are
implementation detail. If your question requires reading them, that
indicates a doc gap — file an issue or open a PR adding the missing
explanation to `docs/`.

## Companion package

`dart_monty_core` is the underlying FFI engine. If you only need
`Monty.exec`, `MontyLimits`, `Monty.typeCheck`, and `MontyResult`
without bridge/extensions, `dart_monty_core` alone is sufficient
— see its own `llms.txt` for the lower-level surface.
